input_constraints: Read-only disc/extraction roster or the currently loaded signed save through Rosters.
Existing 0x54 records only; masked footer writes preserve stars, depth locks and Guardian caps. No rating, roster size, identity or membership changes.
Tier slots 0/2/4/7; loading legacy flags never migrates them. Tier changes trim in UI order with undo.
Assignment replaces active NFL club players only, top N 1..100 per native position code; free agents, prospects and templates are excluded. Invalid signed ratings refuse.
Preview hashes refuse stale application. Every player identity and changed mask is validated before replay; mixed states refuse.
Export contains receipt plus roster_edits compatible with the existing Build writer; extract roster_edits before selecting it in Build.
